# Sociolab (Social Lab)
> Modern Performance Marketing, Direct-Response Creative Studio, and Influencer Automation Agency.

## Organization
- Name: Sociolab (Social Lab)
- Founders: Noman Akbar Khan (Co-Founder & Performance Marketer), Khizar (Co-Founder & Creative Director)
- Location: Rawalpindi / Islamabad, Pakistan (serving regional & global clients)
- Website: https://sociolab.com.pk
- Primary Specialty: Full-Funnel Paid Advertising (Meta, Google, TikTok), In-House Short-Form Video Production, and Automated Creator Marketing.

## Core Capabilities
- Paid Media Acquisition: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Dynamic Creative Testing (DCT), Conversion API (CAPI) Integration, Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max), full-funnel remarketing loops.
- Creative Production: Direct-response short-form video (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts), educational carousels, ad fatigue variation testing, script frameworks (PAS, BAB), multi-variation cutdowns.
- Creator Marketing: Automated influencer outreach using n8n workflows, PR gifting management, Partnership / Spark Ads whitelisting, creator vetting and contract automation.
- Conversion Rate Optimization: Funnel troubleshooting, landing page audits, chat/CRM lead triage optimization, automated abandoned cart and welcome email flows.

## Key Clients
- Exact Fashion Store (Retail & Apparel) — 314 WhatsApp Chats @ PKR 22.79 per chat
- Sehgal Motors (Automotive Accessories) — 3.8x Target ROAS
- GCC Startups (Business Consulting) — 47% Lower Cost Per Lead
- Tanzeem (E-Commerce & Fashion) — 2.7x ROAS in 30 Days

## Differentiators
- In-house creative studio (no outsourced video production)
- Automated creator outreach via n8n backend workflows
- Server-side Conversion API (CAPI) for signal resilience
- WhatsApp-first lead qualification and sales triage
- 30-day onboarding roadmap with measurable milestones
- Month-to-month contracts (no long-term lock-in)

## Process
- Days 1-7: Strategic Intake & Tracking Foundation (Meta Pixel, CAPI, ad account audit)
- Days 8-14: Studio Production & Creator Seeding (batch shoots, product seeding)
- Days 15-21: Campaign Rollout & Partnership Ads (prospecting, organic calendar, whitelisting)
- Days 22-30: Algorithmic Optimization & Scaling Blueprint (budget reallocation, Month 2 plan)
